Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recodred statement is about the collision you were
involved in at the intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?
A: Yes, I understand. Go ahead.
Q: Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?
A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light, going about the speed limit. I had my lights on and I was
paying attention to the cross traffic like I always do.
Q: What did you notice as you entered the intersection?
A: A dark sedan came from my right side. It didn't look like it was slowing down at all. I hit the brakes, but it was too
late, and it hit the driver's side of my car.
Q: Did you see a signal for the other vehicle?
A: I think it had a red light, but I can't say for certain. I was focused on my own light.
Q: Where did your vehicle end up after the collision?
A: It rolled a little bit and stopped against the curb on the far side of the intersection. The airbags on my side went off.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes. A paramedic checked me at the scene, and I went to an urgent care clinic later that evening. They diagnosed
a neck strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatory medication.
Q: How are you feeling today?
A: My neck is still stiff, especially when I turn my head to check my blind spots. I've been doing the exercises the clinic
gave me, and it's slowly getting better.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your account?
A: Just that I was driving carefully and I'm willing to provide any records you need.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
